statements.statement: Chair said the committee will not present the community with a bill of this size to fund lost grant positions from the local budget.
A member said schools got an increase in Chapter 70 last year that was not fully absorbed; expects only about 2% going forward.
Administration identified shifting about 20% of the Title I coordinator salary to the local budget.

warnings.prediction: Local budget cannot absorb all grant-funded positions; not all will be funded when ESSER ends
Loss of ESSER revenue will be pretty impactful and the social-emotional needs will persist
Staff may leave the district if told now that their positions will be eliminated
Additional staff may be needed to comply with the new discipline law

warnings.condition: if stabilization or other funds are not accessed
warnings.prediction: Capital requests from the fire department could pull from lower-priority capital requests
